label_informed_disclosure: VV with positive burn direction was selected after examining the SAR sign against the reference. The VH positive variant is also label-informed because VH sign changes by damage severity. Class counts for pipeline variants and SAR null test v2 results were seen before this config was frozen; no accuracy metrics were seen.

primary_outcome.pixel_population: all pixels; undecided is counted as not predicted burned
primary_outcome.uncertainty: Paired spatial block bootstrap using the same sampled blocks for both variants in each replicate.

pre_registered_expectation: Optical-only is expected to match or exceed fused on the real clear-sky data because the reference is dNBR-derived. Fusion's value is judged mainly through the SYNTHETIC cloud ablation and fused versus SAR-only.

reliability.combine_pre_and_post: minimum of pre- and post-date alpha

breakpoints.method: label-free robust median plus scaled MAD

primary.valid_land: Not SCL class 6 and not NoData on either the pre- or post-date SCL image.

temporal_discount.gate_reason: Both post-fire images are after fire_end; therefore the asymmetric k=2 discount is not applied. The uniform temporal discount with tau=14 days is applied.

disclosed_variants.settings: Same SAR filter, centering, robust breakpoints, reliability, and temporal discount as primary.
Primary USGS dNBR and SCL reliability with temporal discount on.
Primary VV SAR settings with temporal discount on.
Primary SAR settings with temporal discount on.
All other settings identical to primary.
All other settings identical to primary.
Primary settings except temporal discount is disabled.
Primary settings except dNBR uses the previously recorded Otsu breakpoints.

disclosed_variants.change_transform: absolute value of AOI-land-median-centered VH change
disclosed_variants.breakpoints: Label-free median plus 1 and 2 scaled MAD as defined for primary.
disclosed_variants.label: EXPLORATORY; cannot replace or modify the primary result.

reference_variants.operation: Repair grading geometry once, subtract those grading polygons from the fire delineation, then rasterize.

rasterization.grid: Same fixed 20 m analysis grid for every output and reference.

common_mask: valid prediction and evidence in every registered output
valid reference pixels for both reference variants
report: common-mask pixel count and burned prevalence for each reference variant
burned-class IoU, F1, precision, and recall
undecided fraction; undecided is not predicted burned for the all-pixel metrics
burned-class IoU, F1, precision, and recall restricted to decided pixels
recall by damage_grade: High, Moderate high, Moderate low, Low
trivial baselines: all burned, none burned, and prevalence-rate prediction
scoring.prevalence_baseline: Analytical expected binary metrics for a prediction positive with probability equal to reference burned prevalence; report separately for each reference variant.

uncertainty.grid_anchor: upper-left origin of the fixed analysis raster
statistics: IoU and F1 confidence intervals for each scored variant
paired fused-adaptive-primary minus optical-only IoU and F1
paired fused-adaptive-primary minus VV SAR-only IoU and F1
uncertainty.resampling_rule: Resample spatial blocks with replacement and use the same sampled blocks for all variants and references in each replicate. No pixel bootstrap.
uncertainty.metric_rule: For each replicate and metric, sum TP, FP, and FN over sampled blocks first, then compute the ratio from those summed counts.

record_in_each_results_file: SHA-256 of the exact configs/checkpoint_c.json bytes used
git commit hash of the committed configuration
results_provenance.hash_timing: Compute the config SHA-256 from the final frozen file at scoring time; record the commit hash containing that file.

supporting_analyses.dnbr_vs_ems_grading: Restate the previously measured Spearman correlation of 0.90 and report dNBR means by damage grade.

synthetic_cloud_ablation.label: SYNTHETIC
synthetic_cloud_ablation.positions: Three non-overlapping raster-grid blocks selected by descending overlap with the fire delineation, ties by row then column; require at least 10% of each block to overlap the delineation.
synthetic_cloud_ablation.report: Optical-only, VV SAR-only, and adaptive fused results inside each synthetic block and outside the block, without changing any other alpha or parameter.

supporting_analyses.conflict: Map adaptive-fusion conflict as 1 minus conjunctive height; describe its spatial association with coast, slope, land cover, and severity without causal claims.

freeze_rule: Do not change any parameter, breakpoint multiple, sign, fusion rule, mask, or rasterization rule after scoring starts. Report poor results as observed. Any later change is a separately labelled EXPLORATORY run and never replaces the primary.
